text.en: These Rules may be cited as the Miscellaneous Offences (Method and Procedure of Compounding) Rules. Form
An offer to compound shall be in such form as the Permanent Secretary of Ministry of Home Affairs may determine.

(1) When an offer to compound any offence is made and accepted, payment for it shall be made in cash, at the place where the offer was made or at the office or police headquarters of the appropriate Police District specified in the offer to compound.

(2) Subject to subrule (3), such payment shall be made within 7 days from the date the offer was made.

(3) On an appeal, the Chairman of any Municipal Board, the District Officer, the Director General of Public Works, the Officer Commanding Police District or the Director of Environment, Parks and Recreation as the case may be, may extend the period referred to in subrule (2) to 14 days if he thinks fit.
When payment is made in accordance with rule 3(1), a receipt shall be issued for such payment to the person to whom the offer to compound was made. Effect of payment

On the payment of such sum of money for the offer to compound, no further proceedings shall be taken against the person who has been reasonably suspected of having committed an offence. 6 Miscellaneous Offences

(a) fails to appear at the office or police headquarters of the appropriate Police District specified in the offer to compound;

(b) fails to make payment within the period referred to in rule 3(2) or (3); or

(c) furnishes any information which is false or misleading, shall be issued with a summons.
